CVE-2025-31344.title: Heap-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in openEuler giflib on L ...
CVE-2025-31344.description:
Heap-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in openEuler giflib on Linux. This vulnerability is associated with program files gif2rgb.C.

This issue affects giflib: through 5.2.2.

CVE-2025-31334.title: Issue that bypasses the "Mark of the Web" security warning functi ...
CVE-2025-31334.description: Issue that bypasses the "Mark of the Web" security warning function for files when opening a symbolic link that points to an executable file exists in WinRAR versions prior to 7.11. If a symbolic link specially crafted by an attacker is opened on the affected product, arbitrary code may be executed.
